units_checked.description: ids of every unit in your batch that you judged; a unit you ran out of turns for is left out

findings.description: exactly one entry per unit in units_checked

unit.description: the unit id from the batch file

text.description: two or three sentences: the verdict and the main reason

parts.description: every separate request of the TODO (its numbered steps, bullets and Done-when conditions), each judged on its own

part.description: the request, in a few words quoted or paraphrased from the TODO

evidence.description: for a done part: at least one reference that shows it is in the checkout

ref.description: a commit SHA (7 to 40 hex characters), a repo-relative path:line, or a test file name or test_that description

what.description: one line: what this reference shows

searched.description: for not done or unclear: what you searched for and where

gap.description: for undone: what is missing or no longer meets the TODO; else empty
